meta.name: docs-pipeline-automation
meta.description: Build repeatable data-to-Docs pipelines from Sheets and Drive sources. Use for automated status reports, template-based document assembly, and scheduled publishing workflows.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从表格和云端文件自动生成文档并定时发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从数据源生成固定格式的文档并自动发布
copy.tagline_en: Automatically generate and publish documents from Sheets and Drive
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly generate formatted documents from data sources and publish them automatically

howto.what: Claude 会根据你定义的流水线，从 Google Sheets 和 Drive 提取数据，填充模板，自动生成 Google Docs 文档。
howto.when: 当你需要从电子表格或云端硬盘数据自动生成重复性文档（如状态报告、模板化文档）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个从销售数据生成周报的流水线。
say.note: Claude 会引导你定义数据源和模板。

say.text: 用这个模板和那个表格，生成一份项目状态报告。
say.note: Claude 会执行流水线并输出文档。

howto.what_en: Claude builds pipelines that extract data from Google Sheets and Drive, fill templates, and auto-generate Google Docs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to automate repetitive document generation from spreadsheet or Drive data, such as status reports or template-based documents.

say_en.text: Create a pipeline to generate weekly reports from sales data.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to define sources and template.

say_en.text: Use this template and that sheet to generate a project status report.
say_en.note: Claude will run the pipeline and output the document.
